mainContent.selectProjectDescription: Select a project from the sidebar to start coding with Claude. Each project contains your chat sessions and file history.
mainContent.createProjectMobile: Tap the menu button above to access projects
mainContent.createProjectDesktop: Create a new project by clicking the folder icon in the sidebar

landing.title: Start a Pixcode workspace
landing.description: Choose a project, start a new chat, or launch Orchestration with one goal. Orchestration manages the CLI agents you select, shows every step, and surfaces errors directly.
landing.startOrchestrationDescription: Creates an automatic project and opens the Orchestration screen with agent control and run history.
landing.startChatDescription: Creates a folder automatically and opens the normal chat screen with one agent.
landing.sidebarHint: When you select an existing project from the sidebar, chat history, files, git status, tasks, and orchestration stay in the same main screen.
landing.createProjectDescription: Add an existing workspace or create a folder, then open the provider picker for coding.

orchestration.title: Orchestration
orchestration.subtitle: Give one goal inside {{project}}; choose the CLI workers, duplicate any CLI when needed, and assign work directly or let the coordinator split it.
orchestration.goalPlaceholder: Example: Fix the auth screen for single-port deployment, capture errors, and verify with lint and typecheck.
orchestration.replayApprovalRequired: Replay needs approval before repeating a step with prior shell, network, or file-write activity.
orchestration.needAgent: Enable at least one CLI worker.
orchestration.needRoles: Assign at least one enabled agent to these role(s) for this mode: {{roles}}.

liveTrading.label: 8024 live trading screen
liveTrading.prompt: Hi, please create a small project and then run it on port 8024. I want a Binance FAPI-connected TradingView-style design with a TradingView chart and a star/favorites system on the left. Split the work logically and manage the process automatically.

orchestration.emptyHistory: No runs yet. Write a goal and start the agents.
orchestration.notSelectedDescription: Select a previous run or start a new goal. Agent messages, errors, change summaries, and preview outputs appear here.
orchestration.loadFailed: Run details could not be loaded.
orchestration.traceEmpty: No trace events match the current filters.
orchestration.traceLoadFailed: Trace timeline could not be loaded.
orchestration.noChangeSummary: The final summary is not ready yet. A readable Markdown summary appears here when the agents finish.
orchestration.prepareTeamFromReport: Prepare agent team from this report
orchestration.prepareTeamDescription: The debate output was turned into a new Agent Team prompt. Edit it, then move it into Agent Team mode.
orchestration.reportToPromptPrefix: Prepare and execute an agent team from the following debate/decision report. Split the needs into tasks, propose sensible assignments for the available CLI agents, and start only after user confirmation.
orchestration.noAgentMessages: This agent has not produced a message yet. If the run failed, the real CLI error appears above.
orchestration.noOutputs: No change summary, preview, or command output yet.

multi_model_review.name: Multi-model review
multi_model_review.description: Enabled CLI agents review the same goal separately, then one enabled agent aggregates the result.

sequential_handoff.name: Sequential handoff
sequential_handoff.description: Agents plan, implement, and review in order. Disabled CLI steps are skipped.

adversarial_debate.name: Decision debate
adversarial_debate.description: Agents propose, critique, respond, and produce a final recommendation.

agent_team.name: Agent team
agent_team.description: A coordinator reads the goal and active CLI instances, assigns work, then collects the result.

orchestration.teamHint: Each row is one CLI worker. You can create multiple Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Qwen, or OpenCode workers and give each a different assignment.
orchestration.fallbackAgentHint: If a CLI step fails, Pixcode retries that step with this backup agent.
orchestration.customRolePlaceholder: Example: Security, Mobile UX, DB architecture

roleHints.default: Leave empty and the coordinator assigns this agent from the goal.
roleHints.agent_team: Pick backend, frontend, or review stages, or leave agents on auto.
roleHints.multi_model_review: Enabled agents review; if a report role is selected, that agent aggregates the final summary.
roleHints.sequential_handoff: Agents run in your selected order; assignment text defines each step.
roleHints.adversarial_debate: Stage selection is optional in decision debate; if left empty, the system assigns selected agents to Proposal, Critique, and Response in order.

orchestration.assignmentPlaceholder: Optional: tell this worker exactly what to handle. Leave empty for coordinator assignment.
orchestration.templateHint: Pick a starter template to fill the workflow, agent roles, and acceptance criteria before launch.
orchestration.hermesSubtitle: Hermes is running inside Pixcode for {{project}} and can coordinate local checks, tests, terminal work, and project operations.
